title: The Day the Plane Fried
lyrics:
(Tempo: Slow, building to a dramatic, swirling climax. instrumentation: Acoustic guitar slowly joined by a driving rockabilly upright bass, then a chaotic wall of sound before fading to silence.)

(Verse 1: Buddy Holly - Vocals clean, slightly breathless)
They tell you the road is a highway to dreams
But nobody mentions the freezing extremes
The heater is broke and the windows are iced
Carl’s toes are frostbit, we’re paying the price
I’m tired of the highways, the rattling bones
I just want a bed and a minute alone
I told Maria I’d call her tonight
Just need a clean shirt, just need a quick flight
I didn’t want wings, just a break from the grind
To leave all these miles of nothing behind

(Verse 2: The Big Bopper - Vocals deep, carrying a heavy weight, losing the usual bravado)
Hello, baby... no, it’s just J.P. now
Sweatin' and shiverin', taking a bow
This flu’s got me down, I can’t fit in those seats
I need out of this bus, I need some relief
Waylon, God bless him, he gave up his chair
Said "Take the plane, Bopper, I’ll see you there."
I got a baby on the way, need to rest up my head
Can’t keep rockin' the nation if I end up dead
Just a quick jump to Moorhead, a skip o'er the snow
The Big Bopper’s tired, he’s ready to go.

(Chorus: All Three - Harmonies tight but tinged with a growing, unnatural wind sound)
The day the plane fried, the day the music cried
We traded the blacktop for a ride in the sky
No fly, just die, spinning out in the white
Trading our tomorrows for a cold winter night
Three boys from the South, chasing the sound
Now we’re falling so fast to the frozen ground.

(Verse 3: Ritchie Valens - Vocals young, urgent, slightly terrified but trying to be brave)
Seventeen years old, man, look at me now
From Pacoima to here, I made it somehow
Donna’s still waiting, the letters I sent
I won a coin toss for the seat that I got lent
Heads I win, tails I lose, Tommy flipped it so high
Didn’t know I was tossing for the right just to die
It’s so dark out that window, the snow’s coming fast
The compass is spinning, the shadows are cast
I’ve never flown before, is it supposed to feel like this?
Like the stomach drops out in a blinding abyss?

(Bridge: Buddy Holly - Tempo accelerates, instruments becoming chaotic)
The engine is whining, the nose tipping down
Where are the lights of the next little town?
Roger is fighting the yoke with his might
But the ground and the sky are the same shade of white
My glasses are fogged, the altimeter spins
This isn't the ending, this is where it begins
The Peggy Sues fade, the Chantilly lace tears
La Bamba goes silent into the freezing air
I just wanted laundry, I just wanted sleep
Now the snow is so heavy, the silence so deep.

(Chorus: All Three - Voices overlapping, desperate, fading into distortion)
The day the plane fried, the day the music cried
We traded the blacktop for a ride in the sky
No fly, just die, spinning out in the white
Trading our tomorrows for a cold winter night
Three boys from the South, chasing the sound
Now we’re falling so fast to the frozen ground.

(Outro: All Three - Acapella, barely a whisper over the sound of wind)
Buddy: Tell Maria I love her.
Bopper: Tell my little one hello.
Ritchie: Tell Donna to wait for me.
All: Into the white, we go... we go...

(Fade to the sound of absolute, chilling wind, then silence.)
